definitions.gloss: elevation drawing; elevation view; front/side elevation
definitions.explanation: A drawing that shows a building as seen from the front, back, or side — representing the exterior as a flat, two-dimensional image. Used in architecture alongside plan views and cross-sections.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立面図|りつめんず}。
examples.english: The elevation drawing of a building.

examples.japanese: {立面図|りつめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外観|がいかん}→外観：12154_gaikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can tell what the building will look like from the elevation drawing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立面図|りつめんず}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立面図|りつめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the front elevation and side elevation drawings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{図面|ずめん}→図面：12023_zumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧・{立面図|りつめんず}・⟦{断面図|だんめんず}→断面図：14837_danmenzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三種類|さんしゅるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Architectural drawings come in three main types: plan, elevation, and cross-section.

notes:
Composed of {立面|りつめん} (vertical face, elevation) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing). A {立面図|りつめんず} depicts a building's exterior from a particular direction — typically the front, rear, or side — showing walls, windows, doors, and the overall shape without perspective distortion.

USAGE:
Standard term in architecture, construction, and civil engineering documents. Often specified by direction: ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{立面図|りつめんず} (front elevation), ⟦{背面|はいめん}→背面：20610_haimen⟧{立面図|りつめんず} (rear elevation), ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧{立面図|りつめんず} (side elevation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立面図|りつめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw an elevation
- {立面図|りつめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare an elevation drawing
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{立面図|りつめんず}: front elevation
- {立面図|りつめんず}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧: elevation and plan views

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧: floor plan, plan view — shows the building from above
- ⟦{断面図|だんめんず}→断面図：14837_danmenzu⟧: cross-section drawing — shows the interior as if sliced
- {外観図|がいかんず}: exterior drawing — similar but may include perspective or 3D rendering
- {透視図|とうしず}: perspective drawing — shows the building with depth and vanishing points
